title: Customer 360
description: One customer group as a 3D knowledge graph: companies, people, contracts, deals, orders, invoices, tickets and what people wrote. A four-act story asks the documents one question per step and lights up the answer. Fictional sample data (Nordlicht group).
insights: Each node is a text document; the story asks them one question per step (local ranking, or live Cognee through the app) and lights up what matched.
Act 1 structure, act 2 contracts and deals, act 3 payments, what people said and orders delivered but not billed, act 4 ranked proposals.
Heat per company is a stated rule of thumb, conclusions from free text are marked Inference, nothing is written to any system.
Fictional sample data. Cognee live needs the Cognee connector and the corpus (npm run cognee:corpus).
prompt: Bundled example: Customer 360 (static mockup, data embedded by npm run sync:mockups; documents for Cognee by npm run cognee:corpus).
